verdict.rationale: Direct probes confirm Helicone serves an llms.txt index at docs.helicone.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Its docs pages are available as raw .md files that tell agents to fetch that index, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is published at swagger.json. Together these give an agent everything needed to read the docs directly. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or other full-content bundle, and no independent or community reports of agents actually being pointed at these docs.
